what: An Elektron-style six-track groovebox for the FM-1, with Elektron Syntakt support. One-press quick-start loops, generators for acid lines, dub chords, held atmospheres and modular bleeps, trig conditions and locks, a DJ filter and FX pad, and the keys set the song's key. Built on JIANT FM.
author: cursedsound
